name: What does luxury construction quality control look like?

mainEntity.name: How do I know a luxury home builder is delivering high-quality workmanship?
mainEntity.text: How do I know a luxury home builder is delivering high-quality workmanship?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury construction quality control should be visible throughout the project, not just at the end. That means the builder is regularly supervising the site, checking trade work, confirming dimensions, and resolving issues before they get buried behind finishes. Strong quality control also includes milestone inspections, photo documentation, punch lists, and close coordination between the builder and subcontractors. For high-end homes, details such as tile alignment, cabinetry fit, trim transitions, waterproofing, and mechanical placement matter as much as the overall design. Homeowners should ask how often the site is reviewed, who manages defects, and how issues are corrected. A builder who treats quality as a process rather than a final inspection is more likely to deliver a home that feels truly finished.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quality control in luxury construction should include regular site supervision, trade coordination, inspection checkpoints, documented punch lists, and finish reviews before handoff. High-quality builders also verify details during installation, not just after the work is complete.
